q: How many spies did Joshua secretly send to look at Jericho?
quote: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim

q: In Jericho, whose house did Joshua's two spies stay in?
quote: So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

q: Where did Rahab hide Joshua's spies from the king of Jericho's men?
why: She risked her life for them.
quote: But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax

q: What did Rahab tell Joshua's spies she believed about the LORD?
a: He is God of heaven and earth
why: She had heard what God did.
quote: for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

q: How did Rahab help Joshua's spies escape from Jericho?
a: Let them down by a rope
why: Her house was built into the wall.
quote: Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window

q: What did Joshua's spies tell Rahab to tie in her window?
why: It would mark her house to be spared.
quote: you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down

q: When Jericho fell, why did Joshua spare Rahab and her family?
quote: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men

q: How many days did God tell Israel to march around Jericho once a day?
quote: March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.

q: At Jericho, what did seven priests carry in front of the ark?
why: They blew them as they marched.
quote: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark.

q: On the seventh day at Jericho, how many times did Israel march around the city?
why: Then the priests blew the horns.
quote: Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times

q: While marching around Jericho, what did Joshua tell the people not to do?
why: They had to wait for his signal.
quote: do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout.

q: After the seventh time around Jericho, what did Joshua command the people?
why: The LORD had given them the city.
quote: Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

q: When the people gave a great shout at Jericho, what happened?
quote: When they heard the blast of the horn, the people gave a great shout, and the wall collapsed.

q: Before the battle of Jericho, what did the LORD tell Joshua?
a: I have delivered Jericho to you
quote: Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand

q: After Moses died, whom did the LORD speak to as Israel's new leader?
quote: the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant

q: When Joshua became leader, what did God command him to be?
why: God was with him wherever he went.
quote: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous?

q: How did Israel cross the Jordan River under Joshua?
quote: while all Israel crossed over the dry ground

q: After crossing the Jordan, how many stones did Israel take from the river?
quote: Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan

q: What did Joshua say he and his house would do?
quote: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!

q: God told Joshua to meditate on the Book of the Law how often?
quote: meditate on it day and night

q: God promised Joshua, “As I was with Moses, so will I be with…”
quote: As I was with Moses, so will I be with you

q: God promised Joshua every place his foot would tread on would be what?
why: God kept His promise to Moses.
quote: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread

q: Who sent men to Rahab to demand she bring out the Israelite spies?
quote: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab

q: Where did Rahab tell the spies to hide for three days?
why: Their pursuers would not find them.
quote: Go to the hill country

q: Rahab told the spies Jericho had heard how the LORD dried up which sea?
quote: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you

q: When Israel came to cross the Jordan, what state was the river in?
quote: Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season.

q: At the Jordan, the water stopped when whose feet touched it?
why: God went ahead of His people.
quote: as soon as the priests carrying the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge

q: Why did Joshua have stones taken from the Jordan and set up?
wrong: To make an altar for Baal
why: Children would ask what they meant.
quote: to serve as a sign among you.

q: Near Jericho, who did the man with the drawn sword say He was?
quote: I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.

q: What did the Commander of the LORD's army tell Joshua to take off?
quote: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.

q: Who took things devoted to the LORD after Jericho fell?
quote: Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart.

q: Where did Achan hide what he took from Jericho?
a: In the ground in his tent
quote: They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.

q: How did the people of Gibeon trick Joshua?
a: Pretended to come from far away
why: They wore old clothes and carried moldy bread.
quote: carrying on their donkeys worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.

q: When Joshua prayed over Gibeon, what stood still in the sky?
quote: So the sun stood still and the moon stopped

q: In his farewell, what did Joshua ask Israel to choose this day?
quote: then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve

q: How old was Joshua when he died?
why: He was the servant of the LORD.
quote: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.

q: How old was Caleb when he asked Joshua for the hill country?
quote: So here I am today, eighty-five years old

q: From which place did Joshua send the two spies to Jericho?
quote: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim

q: How long did Rahab tell the spies to hide in the hill country?
quote: Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned

q: When the Jordan stopped, near which city did the water pile up upstream?
why: It was in the area of Zarethan.
quote: It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan

q: Who carried the twelve stones out of the Jordan?
why: Each carried a stone on his shoulder.
quote: So Joshua summoned the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe

q: After Jericho fell, where did Israel put the silver, gold, bronze, and iron?
why: It was set apart for God.
quote: they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.

q: What kind of beautiful cloak did Achan take at Jericho?
why: He also took silver and gold.
quote: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar

q: Achan, who took devoted things from Jericho, was from which tribe?
why: His sin brought trouble on Israel.
quote: of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart.

q: When Joshua told the sun to stand still, over which valley did the moon stop?
quote: O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.

q: In which book was the day the sun stood still also written?
quote: Is this not written in the Book of Jashar?

q: Where was Israel's camp when the Gibeonites came asking for a treaty?
why: They pretended to be from far away.
quote: They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal

q: How many years had God kept Caleb alive since His promise to Moses?
quote: He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses
